name: agent-passport-system
description: Governance infrastructure for AI agents. Ed25519 identity, scoped delegation, enforcement gateway under 2ms, 5-gate commerce, Merkle attribution, bilateral receipts (in-toto Decision Receipt v0.1), Instruction Provenance Receipt for instruction-context drift detection, Wave 1 accountability primitives (action, authority-boundary, custody, contestability, bundle), evidentiary type safety (claim/evidence registry, claim verifier, contestation cascade), payment rails (ACP / MPP / AP2 mandate / Stripe Issuing / Nano reference adapter) with DID URI signing and rotation-aware verifiers, Delegated Action Evidence release (bilateral pair reconciliation, revocation observation receipts, evidence bundles with per-axis claim-state reporting, spec 4.1 action_ref canonicalization, jurisdiction selection records). 6,289 tests in the 8.0.0 release, 152 MCP tools. SDK 8.0.0 and MCP 7.0.0 on npm, Python 4.3.0 on PyPI, Rust 0.3.0 on crates.io, Go v0.7.0.
author: aeoess
